  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)

  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues

About Us

Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.

The Role

As Vendry’s Business Development Manager, you’ll be the frontline force helping brands kick off their search for the right agency partner, helping to craft their marketing strategies in the process. You’ll be responsible for leading our sales efforts with inbound RFP clients—those who have already expressed interest in starting an agency search through Vendry. This is not a traditional outbound-heavy role. Instead, it’s about deeply understanding each client’s needs, pitching our process, running intro calls, managing follow-ups, and ensuring a seamless transition into the matchmaking phase.

You’ll serve as both consultant and salesperson, ensuring that every interested brand sees the value in Vendry’s approach—and ultimately trusts us to guide them through their agency selection journey.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full sales cycle for inbound agency search clients—from initial inquiry through signed engagement with our partners.
  • Conduct consultative sales calls to understand each client’s marketing needs and present Vendry’s search process.
  • Build and deliver compelling pitch materials and follow-ups that reflect Vendry’s value proposition.
  • Collaborate closely with the Agency Operations team to ensure smooth handoff and client experience.
  • Maintain detailed records in our CRM to track pipeline activity and conversion metrics.
  • Help evolve our sales materials and process based on feedback and performance.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in a sales or client-facing role, ideally in marketing, advertising, or agency services.
  • Proven ability to run structured sales calls and close consultative deals.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Organized, self-motivated, and comfortable managing multiple prospects at once.
  • Experience working in a remote environment and using CRM tools like HubSpot or Salesforce.
  • Based in Canada and able to work full-time remotely.

Why Join Vendry

Joining Vendry means joining a team at the forefront of transforming how brands find their marketing partners. You’ll work directly with marketers at companies big and small, helping them discover agencies that can take their brand to the next level. We’re a collaborative, fast-moving team that values creativity, strategic thinking, and initiative.

If you’re a self-starter with a passion for marketing and building relationships, we’d love to hear from you.

Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

  • Continuous Monitoring: Implement and oversee continuous monitoring processes to ensure ongoing adherence to SOC 2 requirements and other relevant frameworks (e.g., ISO 27001, GDPR)

  • Vendor Risk Management: Utilize Vanta's Vendor Risk Management (VRM) solution to assess and monitor third-party vendors, ensuring compliance with security standards
  • Audit Support: Collaborate with external auditors to facilitate smooth and efficient SOC 2 audits, utilizing Vanta's tools to provide real-time evidence and reporting
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with engineering, IT, and product teams to integrate compliance requirements into SaaS product development and operations

Sobre a Verzo

A Verzo foi fundada em 2015 com o objetivo de auxiliar os hospitais e prestadores de serviço de saúde a aprimorarem seus resultados financeiros. Iniciamos movidos pelo propósito de ajudar a saúde do Brasil e animados com os desafios que o setor propicia.

Começamos como Aliança Hospitalar, prestando serviços de consultoria para hospitais. Logo nos apaixonamos por tecnologia e criamos o sistema VERZO. Com um time qualificado, o VERZO cresceu de forma exponencial e hoje atuamos com hospitais de todos os portes e perfis em todos os cantos do Brasil. Nos tornamos nativos de tecnologia e adotamos o nome VERZO para nossa companhia.

Durante a pandemia, percebemos o impacto causado não só nas instituições mas também nas pessoas. Decidimos lançar novas soluções de simples adesão, rápida implantação e que facilitassem a vida dos profissionais da área da saúde.

Hoje atendemos os hospitais e redes mais exigentes em termos de tecnologia e resultados. Estamos sempre inovando e criando novas soluções em parcerias com nossos clientes.

Viemos para ficar, valorizamos relações duradouras e a satisfação de nossos clientes é nosso principal objetivo.

O que fazemos

Por meio de ciência de dados proprietária, nossas ferramentas trazem um ROI (retorno do investimento) claro e atrativo, além de apoiarmos as equipes na gestão financeira, cadastro, ciclo de receita, suprimentos e fiscal no atingimento de seus objetivos. Já foram identificados mais de R$ 2 bilhões em oportunidades de aumento de lucro para +350 clientes no país.

Formamos parcerias com essas equipes que, com o uso de nossas ferramentas, entregam mais resultados para seus gestores como redução de glosas / bloqueios, aumento da rentabilidade de medicamentos e materiais médicos, tanto via redução de custos quanto aumento de receita e revisão de mix, e automatização de processos de controle da cadeia de fornecedores e fiscais. Além disso, otimizamos processos internos via tecnologia para liberar tempo da equipe para dedicar atenção e esforços ao que realmente gera valor.

Tudo que desenvolvemos foi com base no feedback das dores destas equipes em diversos hospitais Brasil afora. Conhecemos profundamente as necessidades do setor e sabemos como ajudar.

Prêmios e reconhecimentos

A Verzo é celebrada por sua excelência em inovação e qualidade de serviço. Fomos honrados com diversos reconhecimentos ao longo de nossa história como os destaques de “Tendência para a Saúde em 2024” pela Revista Medicina S / A em 2024, “Top Latin America HealthTech” pela HeathCare Tech Outlook em 2022, e selecionados pela Endeavor como uma das empresas de alto impacto no Brasil por meio do programa Scale Up Endeavor no mesmo ano.

Descrição da vaga e responsabilidades

Estamos em busca de um Executivo de Vendas para integrar nossa equipe. As principais responsabilidades da posição incluem:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes.
  • Gerenciar funil de vendas de ponta a ponta: prospecção, qualificação, apresentações, propostas e fechamento.
  • Conduzir reuniões de demonstração do produto.
  • Negociar aspectos comerciais e garantir a melhor experiência do cliente durante o processo comercial.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Marketing e Customer Success para alinhar estratégias e melhorar a jornada do cliente.
  • Alimentar e organizar o CRM, garantindo previsibilidade de pipeline.
  • Atingir e superar metas de vendas.

Local de trabalho

O trabalho será remoto, permitindo desempenho das funções de onde desejar. Por vezes, haverá necessidade de viagens para eventos e encontros presenciais com clientes.

Regime de contratação:

Contrato PJ.

Requisitos mínimos

Ao liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento de negócios, você desempenha um papel crucial no crescimento da Verzo e na melhoria contínua da saúde no Brasil. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para o sucesso dos hospitais parceiros, proporcionando resultados tangíveis e impactando positivamente a qualidade dos serviços de saúde oferecidos.

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em saúde, tecnologia e SaaS.
  • Histórico consistente de atingimento ou superação de metas.
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, consultiva e orientada a soluções.
  • Possuir conhecimento do setor de saúde e do segmento hospitalar.
  • Capacidade de lidar com diferentes perfis de clientes e influenciadores de decisão (C-level, gestores e técnicos).
  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas e ferramentas de CRM.
  • Disponibilidade para participação em eventos e encontros presenciais que envolvam viagens.
  • Imersão no entendimento dos produtos da Verzo e nas metodologias de vendas, com foco em SPICED, SPIN e CHALLENGER SALE.

O que valorizamos

  • Experiência prévia no setor de saúde.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo e orientado a resultados.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico e de rápido crescimento.
  • Interesse genuíno em gerar impacto positivo no setor de saúde, via inovação, inteligência de dados e tecnologia.
  • Possuir contatos com profissionais do setor e / ou carteira de clientes ativa.

Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e explorar como podemos construir uma jornada de sucesso juntos.

Se você está em busca de uma oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa que valoriza a inovação e a excelência na saúde, a Verzo é o lugar ideal para você. Venha fazer parte do nosso time e contribuir com a vida!

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
  • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
  • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Customer Experience
  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles
  • Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program / Project management
  • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
  • Experience with Networking / Security Products
  • Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues

    • Additional Information

    The Team

    The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.

    Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

    As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.

    Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.

    Our Commitment

    We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

    We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

    Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

    All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

description:
Venue Operations Manager – 8 Host Cities (Brazil)

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil


Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.


THE POSITION

Reporting to Senior Venue Operations Manager, and working alongside the FIFA Tournament & Venue Operations team in Zurich, the Venue Operations Manager is responsible for ensuring that the stadium is delivered in full compliance with FIFA Hosting Requirements and for leading the operational delivery of all FWWC2027 matches and non-matchday activities at the venue.
The tournament will be staged across 8 stadiums in Brazil, and we’re recruiting one Venue Operations Manager for each host city:

  • Belo Horizonte - Estádio Mineirão
  • Brasília - Estádio Nacional
  • Fortaleza - Arena Castelão
  • Porto Alegre - Estádio Beira-Rio
  • Recife - Arena de Pernambuco
  • Rio de Janeiro - Estádio do Maracanã
  • Salvador - Arena Fonte Nova
  • São Paulo - Arena Itaquera

Please apply only if you currently live in one of these cities or can relocate there independently.

The position requires the effective and efficient management of all venue operations, ensuring seamless coordination with FIFA’s functional areas as well as internal and external stakeholders. Key areas of focus include transparency, communication, issue escalation, problem-solving, innovation, and the use of reporting tools to guarantee operational excellence.

The Venue Operations Manager will act as a coordinator, facilitator, and decision-maker at the stadium. Together with the FIFA27 Senior Venue Manager, the FIFA FWWC Lead Venue Management team, and the FIFA27 Head of Operations, this role holds ultimate responsibility for venue event planning, operational readiness, and on-site implementation, in close collaboration with all stakeholders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible for the operational delivery of each match day and non-match day at the venue.
  • Will liaise with all functional areas including Competitions, Broadcast, Media, Dressing & Signage, Fan Operations, Pitch Management, Partnerships Rights Delivery, Technical Services & Overlay, Stadium Entertainment, Ticketing, Hospitality, Technology, FTI (Football Technology Innovation), Catering as well as other functional areas such as Services (Logistics, Transport, Guest Management) and Safety, Security, Accreditation & Access and Workforce and Volunteer Management, to ensure the smooth, efficient and effective operation at the venue for all constituent groups.
  • Establish constructive communication channels between FIFA, FIFA27, venue and local authorities and stakeholders.
  • Co-ordinate with all stakeholders (i.e. Host City authorities, venue operators, public transport, police & emergency services) at a venue level through regular coordinated meetings and/or workshops, to ensure the smooth running of events at the venue.
  • To integrate all relevant operational plans into effective venue plans.
  • To assess and validate FIFA’s event requirements to the reality of the venue.
  • Integration of all relevant functional area operational plans into the stadium environment.
  • Risk identification and mitigation across the venue.
  • Supervise and support stadium renovation and construction projects, assuring FIFA requirements are met.
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Contribution to workshops, seminars and meetings with FIFA, FIFA27, Host Country and site authorities.
  • Coordination of policies, requirements and planning with FIFA, FIFA27, Host Country and site authorities.
  • Co-ordination, planning and delivery of official test events.
  • Plan, manage and implement a good quality and cost-efficient on-site support, service and operations for all relevant FIFA departments as well as other stakeholders (i.e. sponsors, service providers, etc.).
  • Organize and lead Stadium Inspection Tours.
  • Full support to functional areas on site visits, activities and post inspection BIM360 follow up.
  • Manage and review the Stadium budget including regular reporting.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 8 years of management experience in multi-purpose arenas, professional sports clubs, or large-scale international sporting events.
  • Proven ability to lead large, multidisciplinary teams with strong stakeholder management skills across international and multicultural environments.
  • Excellent communication and crisis management skills, with the ability to remain calm under pressure and provide decisive leadership.
  • Strong knowledge of event planning, operations, and project management processes.
  • Familiarity with the host stadium and its operational environment will be considered an asset.
  • Demonstrated experience in the development and integration of operational plans across multiple functional areas (e.g., security, spectator services, media, broadcast, hospitality).
  • Experience in budgeting, financial oversight, and resource management for large-scale events.
  • Strong understanding of health & safety, risk management, and security regulations in stadium operations.
  • Proven track record in managing complex international projects involving multiple stakeholders and authorities.

Education

  • University degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education).
  • Bilingual - Brazilian Portuguese and English
  • Strong administrative and IT skills including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong team player, able to work collaboratively while meeting tight deadlines.
  • Solution-oriented mindset with persistence, resilience, and a positive attitude under pressure.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage high workloads efficiently during peak operational periods.
  • Sound judgment, critical problem-solving ability, and capacity to make key decisions under pressure.
  • Effective leadership skills, including motivational leadership, negotiation, and relationship management.
  • High levels of energy, adaptability, and entrepreneurial spirit.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively across diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Experience or knowledge of the local culture and market will be considered an advantage.
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast-changing environment.
  • Adaptable and culturally sensitive, with proven experience working across international and cross-cultural contexts.


Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Based in one of the listed cities (Belo Horizonte, Brasília, Fortaleza, Porto Alegre, Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Salvador & São Paulo) or able to relocate there independently

title: Escalation Manager
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks everything starts and ends with our mission :

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.

Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Description

Your Career

The Escalation Manager position is a strategic, high-visibility role that provides the highest level of escalation for customer issues that are jeopardizing the Palo Alto Networks business relationship and / or sales opportunities with key customers.

The Escalation Manager will lead and manage the resolution of customers' critical issues by forming and leading an interdepartmental, cross-functional, and geographically dispersed Palo Alto Networks virtual team which are formed based on the customer and escalation needs.

In leading the virtual team, the escalations Manager will liaise with and work across various Palo Alto Networks functional organizations and business units, and with all levels of the company; from Support, Sales, Product management, and development engineers to management and corporate executives.

Your Impact

  • Escalation Leadership
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Drive clear intake, scope, priority, exit criteria and end to end process to achieve streamlined escalation resolution
  • Drive global consistency across portfolio and customers
  • Maintain and improve procedures for customer and field personnel for escalation handling
  • Handle direct customer leadership and technical audiences as appropriate
  • Expedite Resolution
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Strong ability to influence and be effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account and issues
  • Clear accountability on relevant owners on driving to target service-level Objectives(SLO) and intermediate milestones leading up to it
  • Interlock with Executive Sponsors to help resolve roadblocks in a timely manner
  • Communication and Reporting
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales, support, product teams and other invested parties
  • Effective use of dashboards and keen understanding of how to use data to help deliver the outcomes needed and track progress towards SLO
  • Set clear customer expectations and ensure timely updates on troubleshooting and resolution action plans for internal and customer facing communications
  • Risk Management
  • Make informed decisions on elevating urgency and apply relevant focus to solve for a situation with right governance, guardrails and reviews in place
  • A “whatever it takes” customer-first attitude and a willingness to go the extra mile to foster customer success
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Retrospective and Preventive Measures
  • Retrospectives and PostMortem to help improve the process / system / product
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future problems
  • Recognitions and reporting on problem areas which will give insight to the magnitude of the issue through the amount of cases or number of customers impacted or related to these areas
  • Understanding of techniques to predict risks using data and AI models and systematic approach to address
  • Co-create and pilot proactive programs to reduce likelihood of customer and field escalations

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Customer Experience
  • 10+ years of customer-facing sales and / or service delivery roles
  • Past experience as Escalations Engineer / Manager, Technical Account Management, Engineering Management, Customer Support Management, or similar roles desired
  • Customer centric attitude and focus on providing best-in-class service for customers and collaborators
  • Program / Project management
  • Manage critical issues in a cross-functional environment that includes working with support, customer success, professional services, sales, customers, and partners to resolve complex and critical issues
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize with a goal of driving issues to closure on behalf of the customer
  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, Asana, Tableau, JIRA and experience in running and operating with the SLA / SLO / Milestones paradigm and clarity on what success and corresponding metrics looks like
  • Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong capacity for Influencing, negotiating, and delegating efforts
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, challenging environment with global customers
  • Leadership and communication skills
  • Experience in being able to effectively lead and motivate a team of cross functional professionals
  • Expertise in communicating complex topics in a clear and concise manner to different tiers of audiences(highly technical, less technical, executives, practitioners)
  • Technical skills
  • Experience with Networking / Security Products
  • Knowledge of LAN / WAN technologies, encompassing general routing / switching / security for both branch and data center architectures
  • Ownership for driving progress and resolution of customers' critical issues
  • Engage and lead cross-functional and geographically dispersed teams in the development and execution of action plans to address critical situations
  • Effectively communicate critical issue status to executive staff, sales teams, and other invested parties
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and versatility
  • Demonstrate strong judgment in risk management and problem mitigation, as well as making timely decisions from both business and technical perspectives
  • Strong ability to influence and effective at assigning tasks and responsibilities to successfully achieve all key objectives of the critical account
  • Identify systemic and pervasive issues related to products and / or processes and drive actions to prevent future issues

    • Additional Information

    The Team

    The Escalation Managers are part of the Global Incident and Escalation Management team which part of Global Customer Support and Service teams covering all Palo Alto offerings of cybersecurity platforms and solutions.

    Team is responsible for driving expedited response, remedy, resolution, and learnings for our most critical issues. Escalation Managers(EM) team ensures focused technical leadership, effective coordination and communication, and streamlined decision-making

    As Escalation Managers, each team member will be at the vanguard of our dedication to cybersecurity. Addressing the most pressing situations for our customers, you will hold a central position in solidifying our reputation as the go-to cybersecurity partner. This role demands proactivity, efficiency, an unwavering dedication to constant refinement, and a passion for customer satisfaction.

    Driving continuous learnings and efficiency into the Escalation Management and Product Lifecycle is one of the key areas for the team as we continue our focus on customer experience.

    Our Commitment

    We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple : we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

    We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at

    Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

    All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Rain is the fastest-growing earned wage access (EWA) fintech in the U.S. , serving 3.5 million employees and backed by top investors like QED and Prosus . We’ve raised nearly $400M in funding—including the largest Series A in fintech history —and just closed our Series B to fuel our next stage of hypergrowth.

We’re seeking an experienced Senior IT Support Engineer to join our growing team in a dynamic, remote-first startup environment. The ideal candidate will bring outstanding IT support skills, a deep understanding of cloud-managed infrastructure, and expertise in supporting a globally distributed workforce. You’ll be responsible for providing top-tier support to our global user base and ensuring smooth daily operations across hardware, software, network, and collaboration tools. If you have a proactive attitude, strong technical skills, and an interest in AI technologies, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Remotely design, manage, and troubleshoot IT infrastructure, including cloud-managed networks (LAN / Wi-Fi), and firewalls for our physical office hubs.
  • Lead IT infrastructure and collaboration technology projects for a distributed workforce, ensuring high availability, performance, and security.
  • Manage and enhance Workspace ONE UEM deployments for zero-touch device provisioning, lifecycle management, and security compliance.
  • Drive IT automation initiatives using scripting tools or low-code / no-code platforms to streamline workflows and improve efficiency.
  • Act as a customer experience champion, ensuring responsive, high-quality support for all employees, regardless of their location.
  • Provide expert IT support for our global teams across the US, India, LATAM, and Europe.
  • Administer Google Workspace, including user provisioning, security settings, integrations, and advanced troubleshooting.
  • Oversee the end-to-end IT asset lifecycle for a remote workforce, including procurement, zero-touch deployment, tracking, and secure decommissioning.
  • Support and optimize collaboration tools like Slack, Jira Service Management, Zoom, Confluence, and Google Meet.
  • Standardize and document IT processes, creating robust knowledge bases and support procedures for a remote-first environment.
  • Lead remote onboarding and offboarding operations, coordinating closely with Compliance, People, and Security teams.
  • Contribute to IT compliance efforts (SOC2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS) within a cloud-native infrastructure.

Skills and Qualifications

  • 7+ years of IT Experience, ideally with at least 2 years in a senior or lead role supporting a remote or hybrid workforce. English is a MUST have.
  • Proven experience providing exceptional IT support to a globally distributed, remote workforce.
  • Experience supporting Mac, Linux, and Windows platforms in a corporate environment.
  • Strong expertise in networking principles (TCP / IP, DNS, VPN)
  • Demonstrated success in driving IT automation or process improvements with measurable outcomes.
  • Hands-on experience managing a distributed IT asset lifecycle using modern asset management tools.

  • Solid experience with Workspace ONE UEM or other modern MDM / UEM solutions (e.g., Jamf, Kandji, Intune).
  • Exceptional documentation, project management, and cross-team collaboration skills, essential for a remote-first environment.
  • Prior experience in a startup, fast-paced, or agile environment is highly desirable.
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC2, PCI, ISO 27001.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a customer-focused mindset.
  • Passion for leveraging AI tools in IT operations or familiarity with emerging AI-enhanced IT solutions.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager – Operational Excellence

100% Remote | Full-Time | Work with a Global Team

We’re looking for a driven Project Operations Manager to bring order, discipline, and results to our Sales and Marketing teams — and beyond.

Join our award-winning team! Ranked #170 on the Inc. 5000 list and recognized as a Clutch Award-winning agency. Trivium Group is a full-service Amazon agency helping brands scale profitably on Amazon, but this role goes further: you’ll be part of the Operations team driving structure and performance across our portfolio of businesses.

If you can turn chaos into clear processes, own the tools that show us exactly how we’re performing, and keep fast-moving teams accountable, you’re who we’re looking for.

Your Mission

Turn chaos into clarity and performance. Start with Sales and Marketing — building processes, clean data, and real accountability — then expand the same discipline across our portfolio of businesses. Your job is to make sure we always know exactly how we’re performing, fix what’s broken fast, and push what works even further.

Responsibilities

Sales

  • Oversee and improve Sales team performance, tackling underperformance head-on
  • Own HubSpot at an admin level (pipelines, properties, automations, sequences, dashboards) — with executive-grade reporting that makes KPIs and performance crystal clear
  • Implement corrective action plans when off track, and identify growth opportunities when ahead
  • Analyse dips using our in-house AI tools and lead improvement projects to completion
  • Create a Sales Playbook for every role to ensure consistency and efficiency

Marketing

  • Bring strong management and process discipline to ensure on-time, high-quality delivery
  • Own HubSpot at an admin level as well, as mentioned for Sales.
  • Implement and monitor all processes in ClickUp, ensuring documentation and compliance
  • Manage supplier relationships — clear scope, timely delivery, quality results
  • Align organic marketing with paid media buying for maximum impact
  • Own budget management, tracking ROI on every campaign
  • Learn our brands (including Mina’s personal brand and Trivium) to ensure aligned and effective strategies

Requirements

  • Fluent English (written & spoken) with strong communication skills
  • Hands-on systems implementer: HubSpot admin skills (workflows, custom objects/properties, reports), ClickUp workflow design, advanced Google Sheets/Excel (lookups, pivots, queries). Comfortable unblocking with APIs/zaps when needed.
  • Exceptional process design, implementation, and improvement skills. You love turning chaos into beautiful systems that you design, implement, monitor and constantly improve. You are obsessed with reaching excellence through incremental continuous improvement.

description:
Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn’s suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are : act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

You will work across our JavaScript / TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments.

This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

About the Role

Application Security :

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript / TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI / CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity :

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

    • Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves) :

  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high-value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

    • Additional Security Domains :

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

    • What You Bring to Ledn :

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript / TypeScript / Golang / Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

    • Nice to Haves :

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

    • Culture Fit :

    We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will :

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.

  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

  • As one of the world’s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.

We are currently looking for a seasoned CRM Architect to join our dynamic team. This remote role is an exciting opportunity for a professional with a strong background in Microsoft Dynamics CRM development and leadership skills.

The ideal candidate will possess a deep understanding of CRM architecture, be experienced in crafting customer-facing pages, and be adept at leading a team of junior developers. As a key player in our organization, you will drive the development and integration of CRM solutions to enhance our customer engagement and streamline business processes.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and implementation of Microsoft Dynamics CRM solutions, ensuring alignment with business goals and user needs.
  • Design, build, and maintain customer-facing pages on the CRM Portal using both out-of-the-box capabilities and customizations.
  • Oversee the CRM data model creation and participate actively in its design and maintenance.
  • Conduct code reviews, mentor junior developers, and provide expert guidance on best practices in CRM development.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate CRM with Azure, Power Automate, and other essential systems.
  • Develop and deploy custom applications within Dynamics CRM, ensuring high performance and adherence to business requirements.
  • Facilitate seamless integration of CRM with other systems, ensuring data consistency and accessibility.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues related to the CRM environment.
  • Keep abreast of new CRM features and technologies, advocating for the adoption of innovations that can benefit the organization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5-12 years of experience in CRM development, with a focus on Microsoft Dynamics CRM.
  • Proven track record as a lead developer with experience in guiding and mentoring junior team members.
  • Strong understanding of CRM architecture and data modeling principles.
  • Professional experience in developing CRM Portals with a blend of out-of-the-box and custom solutions.
  • Expertise in HTML, JavaScript, and CSS for portal development.

Preferred Skills and Knowledge

  • Certifications in Microsoft Dynamics CRM are highly desirable.
  • Knowledge of Power Automate and its integration with Dynamics CRM.
  • Experience in creating apps within the Dynamics CRM platform.
  • Familiarity with Azure and its services related to CRM integration.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to work collaboratively in a remote environment.

Tools and Technologies

  • Microsoft Dynamics CRM
  • Power Portals
  • HTML, JavaScript, CSS, c# .Net
  • Azure Services
  • Power Automate
  • Integration and API development tools

As a CRM Developer, you will be at the forefront of our CRM initiatives, driving innovation and excellence. If you are a technical expert with a passion for leading development projects and a knack for solving complex problems, we would love to hear from you. Join us in delivering exceptional CRM solutions that power our business success.

description:
We’re looking for talented professionals, anywhere in the United States, to join us in bringing smart money management and payment solutions to everyone’s fingertips.

At Green Dot, we are evolving to a new and permanent “Work from Anywhere” model designed to maximize the benefits of remote work, promote and enable a strong culture of performance and connectedness, and attract the best and brightest talent who align with our entrepreneurial spirit and mission.

Job Description

Job Title: Lead Analyst, Operational Analytics

Location: Remote
Department: Data Analytics

Reports To: VP Data Analytics

Position Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced team lead to spearhead the development and execution of our data governance strategy. This role requires a strong understanding of data management principles, hands-on experience with SQL querying/scripting, data mapping and a comprehensive grasp of data warehouse architecture. The ideal candidate will play a key role in ensuring data quality, consistency, security, and accessibility across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the data governance team in developing and enforcing data governance policies, standards, and best practices.
  • Partner with data stewards, data architects, and business units to ensure alignment between data governance goals and organizational priorities.
  • Oversee data cataloging, metadata management, and data lineage initiatives.
  • Conduct data mapping activities across various systems and sources.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and database administrators to ensure data warehouse structures support governance initiatives.
  • Identify and resolve data quality issues, define data quality metrics, and implement ongoing monitoring processes.
  • Facilitate data governance councils and working groups to drive awareness, compliance, and engagement across data domains.
  • Champion the adoption of a data-driven culture across the organization through training, communication, and support.
  • Use existing tools such as MicroStrategy, Tableau, Power BI and Excel to build visual representations of data and present that to others.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Management, Engineering or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in data governance, data management, or a related role.
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with data mapping between source systems and data warehouses.
  • Solid understanding of data warehouse structures, data modeling concepts, and ETL processes.
  • Familiarity with data governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Informatica, Alation, or similar) is a plus but not required.
  • Familiarity with reporting tools such as MicroStrategy, Tableau, Power BI and the skills to quickly pick up new Analytics tools.
  • Strong experience working with Excel, developing Pivot Tables and structuring/formatting data.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Position Type: Regular

Pay Range: The targeted base salary for this position is $97,100 to $145,500 per year. The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location.

We’re Here to Support You—Accommodations Upon Request

Green Dot is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, we encourage you to let us know. We will work with you to meet your needs in a way that respects your privacy and ensures equal opportunity. Our goal is to support every applicant in showcasing their talents and potential.

Work Authorization Requirement
At Green Dot Corporation, we value diversity and strive for fair and inclusive hiring practices. However, we are currently unable to offer visa sponsorship. All applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout the duration of employment, without the need for current or future sponsorship.

title: Security Engineer
description:
Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn’s suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are : act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

You will work across our JavaScript / TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments.

This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

About the Role

Application Security :

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript / TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI / CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity :

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

    • Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves) :

  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high-value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

    • Additional Security Domains :

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

    • What You Bring to Ledn :

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript / TypeScript / Golang / Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

    • Nice to Haves :

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

    • Culture Fit :

    We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will :

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

    • A Taste of What We Provide :

  • As one of the world’s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
  • Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job. We remove barriers so you love what you do.

    • We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity. You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

    Ledn Working Environment

    Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment.

    Please note , due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted. As part of our selection process , shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role.

    No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

title: Senior Manager, Legal Counsel FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to FWWC2027 Head of Event Legal, and working alongside the FIFA Legal team in Zurich, the Senior Manager, Legal Counselis responsible for the provision of legal support in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27.

This key position plays an integral part in ensuring the successful organization and staging of FWWC27. The successful candidate will be expected to pick up the responsibilities of the role and deliver results from the outset, working in a collaborative and constructive way across all functional areas connected to the delivery of FWWC27.

The role of Senior Legal Counsel for FWWC27 will be based in the Tournament HQ in Rio de Janeiro and is a full time role, but the term of employment is limited in length and will cease at the end of the FWWC27 once any necessary post-tournament requirements are fulfilled.

Key responsibilities

  • Providing legal support to FIFA27 in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27 across a broad range of legal areas, working alongside the FIFA Legal team in Miami.
  • Planning, setting up and implementing, in collaboration with the FIFA Legal team and FIFA Finance, the tax and corporate structure of FIFA27.
  • Assisting with all corporate, company secretarial and governance matters in respect of FIFA27, including legal, regulatory and FIFA institutional requirements and best practices.
  • Ensuring that the operation of FIFA27 and the staging and organization of FWWC27 complies with all applicable laws and regulations, including all federal, state and municipal laws and regulations.
  • Delivering all necessary legal advice, strategic direction and support during the operational phase, tournament time and wind-down phase of the FWWC27.

Advising, alongside the FIFA Legal team in Miami, on the implementation of the legal framework for the hosting and staging of FWWC27, including:

  • Advising on the implementation of the hosting documentation provided during the bidding process for FWWC27, including hosting agreements, host city agreements, stadium agreements, training site agreements, airport agreements, accommodation agreements and related contractual documentation;
  • Supervising the implementation of the guarantees provided by Brazilian government during the bidding process for FWWC27 across topics such as taxation, immigration, employment and customs; and
  • Supporting the Head of Legal and senior management in its discussions with the Brazilian government and CBF and on the establishment of a FWWC27 event law.

Additional specific areas of responsibility include:

  • Drafting and negotiating service provider agreements and any other contracts to be entered into by FIFA27 in connection with the organization and staging of FWWC27;
  • Managing any contentious matters and disputes that may arise in connection with FWWC27;
  • Advising FIFA and FIFA27 on employment and labour law matters, including drafting employment and human resources contracts, documentation and policies and dealing with employment and labour law disputes;
  • Managing external counsel; and
  • Supporting brand protection and anti-ambush marketing activities as part of the overall brand protection plan developed by FIFA.
  • Coordinating and working closely with other legal divisions within FIFA in relation to the hosting and staging of FWWC27, including in relation to media rights, TV production, content, music, technology, intellectual property, brand protection, sponsorship, marketing, corporate and institutional matters.

Your profile

  • An experienced and skilled lawyer qualified in Brazil with at least 10+ years of experience either in a top firm, large corporate or sporting organization, with experience advising major multinational organizations on a wide range of legal issues.
  • Experience with Administrative and Regulatory Law, Contractual and Civil Law consultancy, Compliance and Data Protection is desirable.
  • Previous experience of legal experience in the sports industry is desirable, particularly experience with the hosting and staging of major sports events. Candidates with a demonstratable interest in the sports industry and a strong commercial legal background will also be considered.
  • Experience recruiting and managing a team.
  • Keen understanding of the various interests and demands of all key stakeholders of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 and a thorough appreciation of how the actions of FIFA27 could affect those interests.
  • Ability to create, develop and maintain strong and reliable relationships with FIFA Senior Management as well as external legal and commercial counterparts.
  • Strong IT skills, including MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Capacity to advise the business when making key decisions through critical problem-solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit, motivational leadership, effective negotiation skills, excellent communication skills and positive relationship-management skills.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • A team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and or multinational organization.
  • Qualified as an attorney in Brazil
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

We partner with firms across financial services, MedTech, media, logistics technology, renewable energy, EdTech, e-commerce, and more. Your work will center on evolving data models, improving system performance, and strengthening the reliability of a high-volume booking system. By collaborating with experienced engineers, you’ll extend and optimize microservices in the booking domain, driving scalability, cost efficiency, and stability. This is an opportunity to apply deep technical expertise while making a meaningful impact in a distributed, innovation-driven environment.

  • Collaborating with an agile team of engineers, product managers, and designers.
  • Working with cutting-edge GenAI tools and technology.

  • Inspiration to positively impact the healthcare experience of millions of patients and providers.
  • A product-driven mindset with relentless focus on user needs.
  • Strong autonomy, accountability, and comfort in a remote-first environment.
  • Passion for engineering fundamentals and promoting best practices in code health, testing, and maintainability.
  • Commitment to fostering diverse and inclusive teams and culture.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit with strong ownership, thriving in fast-changing and ambiguous environments.
  • Ability to craft database schemas, implement REST APIs, and design event-driven queue and stream processing systems, ideally with C#, .NET Core, and AWS.
  • A history of solid and well-rounded system design skills.
  • Leadership by example in testing, deployment, and observability practices.
  • Excellent communication skills: able to dive into technical detail with engineers while presenting clear solutions to non-technical audiences.

  • Experience integrating generative AI tools into daily workflows to automate tasks, drive innovation, and maximize productivity.

  • Career Growth: We have established a career development program accessible for all employees with a 360º feedback that will help us to guide you in your career progression.

This position is remote, based in Sao Paolo, and (at least) twice a year in our beautiful Barcelona office.

This role will spearhead platform monetization, content acquisition for FAST channels, and CTV apps. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying and securing partnerships with top-tier content providers, negotiating deals, and ensuring a diverse, locally relevant, and engaging content lineup that aligns with our strategic objectives. In this role, you’ll manage the local relationships with partners (CTV streaming Apps & FAST Channels) in one of our key regions.

  • Monetizing the OS through endemic partners, following the tools and business models in place. Maintaining good contacts with the buyers of advertisement and driving the revenue growth.

Create strategic partnerships with our existing content providers and explore possibilities for new content providers to join.

Data reporting and analysis of Apps/Content usage, implement partners' content roadmap, and drive engagement. Bridge between partners and internal product & tech teams, legal, and marketing.

  • Deep understanding of the region in terms of local content and trends (distributors, companies, locally relevant content, etc.), industry-contacts / awareness, etc

  • Experience working remotely. You are well organised and disciplined, a self-starter who takes initiative and ownership

title: Clinical Business Lead
description:
Overview

Become a part of our caring community and help us put health first. As Regional Clinical Business Lead, you serve as a key member of the regional clinical team responsible for supporting data-driven clinical strategy, performance monitoring, and continuous quality improvement within the Medicare Advantage program to support improving the health of members. The role requires close collaboration with regional leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with initiatives to drive improved member health outcomes. You will work directly with the Regional Vice President of Health Services (RVP) and Health Services Director (HSD) to advance regional clinical strategy, enable connections with physicians and providers, support innovation initiatives, implement clinical programs, vet new vendor programs, and ensure performance management.

Primary Responsibilities

Data Analytics to Support Clinical Strategy, Performance Reporting, and Monitoring

  • Analyze chronic condition performance so regional clinical leadership can bring insights to provider groups to drive awareness, education and action plans.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of clinical program initiatives through analysis of the downstream impact of such initiatives on facility and provider performance in value-based programs.
  • Identify opportunities for new clinical program initiatives by assessing cost and utilization drivers, inclusive of a chronic condition focus.
  • Prepare data and evaluate performance to support RVP and HSD in governance and delegation oversight committee and interact with the corporate delegation compliance and auditing teams.

Project management and Activity tracking

  • Oversee the planning, execution, and closing of clinical projects to ensure objectives are met within required timelines and budget.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans and resource allocation schedules.
  • Monitor project progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Manage project documentation, reporting, and communication with stakeholders.
  • Evaluate project outcomes, perform data analysis, and present findings to leadership.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to promote best practices and process improvements.
  • Ensure alignment with national and local clinical program requirements and standards.
  • Compliance and Quality Improvement: Participate in continuous quality improvement initiatives, including root cause analysis and best practices to close care gaps.

Vendor/Pilot Program Evaluation and Monitoring

  • Assist in the evaluation of clinical program pilots and vendor supported initiatives through analysis and monitoring of key performance indicators.
  • Review the delegation team audits and, if needed, supplement them with regular reviews to ensure vendor programs comply with regulatory standards and internal policies.
  • Provide insights to inform program scalability and effectiveness.

Other duties as assigned

Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a health-related field (Nursing, Public Health, Epidemiology, etc.)
  • Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in data analytics, quality, project management or process improvement.
  • Proficient in analyzing data from various tools and creating actionable insights (Excel, Tableau, Power BI, databricks).
  • Strong understanding of value-based care, population health, and clinical quality metrics.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proven ability to provide high-quality, responsive service to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence and collaborate across teams.
  • Thrive in a remote work environment with independent work skills.
  • Travel expected 5-15%

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced Degree (such as MSN, MBA, MHA, MPH).
  • Experience in managed care, health plan operations, or Medicare Advantage programs (including various SNP products) or Managed Medicaid.
  • Project management experience or certification (e.g., PMP, Lean Six Sigma).
